notes.general_comments:
1153 candidates took this 30 question multiple choice examination and the mean score was 21.3 which was
higher than the mean score of 19.8 from the previous year.
The questions for which most candidates selected the correct answer were 1, 2, 7, 10, 12, 13, 14, 17, 29 and
30. These questions were answered correctly by 80% or more of the candidates. They covered different
parts of the syllabus and were set to test different skills.
The questions that were answered correctly by fewer than 45% of the candidates were questions 5, 9, 16
